contents.name: §6.1 Retarded Potentials, printed pp. 134-135, eqs. (6.1)-(6.4): the potential form of Maxwell, the Lorenz condition, and the claim with proof that square-box chi = f can always be found

Conditional on the explicitly declared Lorenz gauge G=0, Maxwell is equivalent to the decoupled sourced wave equations; Maxwell alone does not impose the gauge. Reachability requires the independent actual solver interfaces.
